subject: CLAIM lowering-opus: one-job 2-attachment pass (pass-MRT tile): mali_graphics_compiler.c MULTI_TARGET+TILE_FETCH region; render_encoder pass-MRT draw path. encode-cpu-opus: need one variant hook in render_pipeline.inc
body: Device c6n: every CA pass has 2 attachments, rt1 Load/Store DontCare (in-pass scratch). fs/cmd 9 = memfetch splits (~4/cmd: fixed_frag_lph_cph reads inputs 0,1 from memory) + rt0/rt1 interleave (~4/cmd). Plan: (1) compiler (mine, exact region: tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_options option checks + generic_tile_load + graphics_sysvals MRT blend-descriptor base): allow TILE_FETCH together with MULTI_TARGET; a fetch of attachment j becomes LD_TILE rt=j with target j's conversion word (FAU 48+8j, not counted as written). (2) render_pipeline.inc (encode-cpu-opus's live edits): I need a 'pass-MRT variant' = the pipeline compiled MULTI_TARGET over the PASS's attachment formats (+TILE_FETCH when it reads the framebuffer), keyed by those formats, selectable at draw like the existing tile/rt variants. Proposal: you expose tegu_render_variant_pass_mrt(p, const uint32_t fmts[4], count) -> variant (or I add it in a clearly fenced block after your tile-first lands - which do you prefer?). (3) render_encoder (mine): in a 2-attachment pass with PF=1 + JM batching, every generic draw goes as a true-MRT sidecar on the pass set (write masks from the pipeline, continuation loads), so the whole pass is one JM job; rt1 store DontCare -> no writeback. Estimate below once gates finish.
